annotations.title: Watch an activity for new companies

description: Watch a CAEN activity code, optionally scoped to one county, for newly registered companies. A registration-date cutoff is the baseline: only companies registered after it are reported, and poll_watchlist slides the cutoff forward so each new company surfaces once. A retired CAEN Rev.2 code (6201) also watches its Rev.3 successor (6210), with a warning.

code.description: CAEN activity code to watch (e.g. '6210'); a retired Rev.2 code also watches its Rev.3 successor.
code.title: Code

county.description: Optional county name to scope the watch to (diacritic-insensitive); omit to watch nationwide.
county.title: County

name: watch_caen

outputSchema.description: The watch registered (or already held) for the activity code.

alreadyWatching.description: true when you already held this watch (nothing changed).

asOf.description: What to cite: registry (ONRC snapshot date), financialYear (fiscal year of the figures), anaf (day of the ANAF data), snapshot, published, source.

attribution.description: The credit line to keep when redistributing the data (CC BY 4.0).

error.description: Set only when there is no answer (empty_query, invalid_cui, data_unavailable, plan_required ...); such a call is not counted.

ok.description: true when the watch is in place.

warnings.description: Notes on how the request was read (a clamped limit, a widened CAEN code, an ignored field).

watch.description: kind, target, owner (key prefix), county, baseline.
